_comment: Models the desktop app can download. Files are pinned by sha256 (from the Hugging Face repo's file list); both are Apache-2.0 Qwen weights, packaged as GGUF by LM Studio's community repo. Bump file and sha256 together.

models.label: Qwen3.5 9B
models.note: The best answers. Needs 16 GB of memory; a GPU makes it much faster.

models.label: Qwen3.5 4B
models.note: Faster and lighter, for PCs with less memory. Picks tools less reliably.
